intent: Welcome a brand-new lead warmly. Affirm that owning their own home is achievable and that WFG makes the path clear. Invite a first friendly call. Theme: abrir las puertas de su propia casa.
subj_en: Your path home starts here
subj_es: Su camino a casa empieza aqui

intent: Explain in plain, calm language how getting a mortgage with WFG actually works and what to expect step by step. Remove fear and confusion. Invite questions.
subj_en: How it works, made simple
subj_es: Como funciona, hecho simple

intent: Bust the myth that you need 20 percent down. Many buyers qualify with as little as 3 percent down, and some programs allow zero down. Encourage a quick eligibility chat. Do NOT guarantee any program or approval.
subj_en: Less down payment than you think
subj_es: Menos enganche de lo que cree

intent: Give a warm overview of loan options (FHA, VA, conventional, first-time buyer, ITIN) and that WFG finds the right fit for their situation. Invite a call to match them to a program.
subj_en: A loan built for your situation
subj_es: Un prestamo hecho para su situacion

intent: Soft, no-pressure re-engagement. Acknowledge that buying a home is a big step and timing is personal. Open the door to restart whenever they are ready with one simple question.
subj_en: Still thinking it over?
subj_es: Todavia lo esta pensando?

intent: Provide genuine value: why getting pre-approved early gives you confidence and negotiating power, and how WFG guides you. Keep the relationship warm. Educational, not pushy.
subj_en: The smartest first step most buyers skip
subj_es: El primer paso mas inteligente que muchos olvidan

intent: Final low-pressure nurture touch. Let them know the door stays open, invite them to save our contact, and that we are one call away whenever the time is right.
subj_en: We are here when you are ready
subj_es: Aqui estamos cuando usted este listo

intent: Empathetic opener for someone not yet credit-ready. Normalize it (very common, very fixable with time) with zero shame. Position WFG as a partner who will help build a realistic plan to qualify. First step is a friendly call. COMPLIANCE: we are NOT a credit repair company; make NO promises of specific score increases or guaranteed approval.
subj_en: Your homeownership plan starts now
subj_es: Su plan para tener casa empieza ahora

intent: Share general, educational healthy-credit habits (pay on time, keep balances low, avoid opening new debt before applying). Frame as general information, not individualized credit repair advice. Encouraging tone. COMPLIANCE: general education only, no promises.
subj_en: Small habits that move the needle
subj_es: Habitos pequenos que hacen la diferencia

intent: Check in with encouragement. Remind them small steady progress adds up and we are tracking alongside them. Low pressure, supportive.
subj_en: Keep the momentum going
subj_es: Siga con el impulso

intent: Paint the motivating picture of what becomes possible once they qualify (programs, the feeling of owning, generic ranges). Keep them inspired and moving. No specific rate or approval promises.
subj_en: What changes when you are ready
subj_es: Lo que cambia cuando este listo

intent: Invite them to re-check their numbers with a no-pressure pre-qualification conversation. Maybe they are closer than they think. Friendly nudge to reconnect.
subj_en: Let us re-check your numbers
subj_es: Revisemos sus numeros de nuevo

intent: Tapering touch. Still in your corner, no pressure, here whenever they want to pick it back up. Warm and brief.
subj_en: Still in your corner
subj_es: Seguimos a su lado

intent: Final taper touch. When the time is right we are one call away. Keep it short, warm, door open.
subj_en: Whenever you are ready, we are one call away
subj_es: Cuando usted quiera, estamos a una llamada

intent: Congratulate them on being pre-approved / pre-qualified. Explain briefly what it means and the momentum it gives them when shopping. Outline next steps. COMPLIANCE: pre-approval is not a final commitment to lend and is subject to conditions, verification, and property approval.
subj_en: Congratulations, you are pre-approved
subj_es: Felicidades, esta precalificado

intent: Confirm we received their application and thank them. Reassure and set expectations for what happens next and the rough timeline. Tell them how to reach us with questions.
subj_en: We received your application
subj_es: Recibimos su solicitud

intent: Let them know their loan is now in processing. We are verifying details and may request a few items. Reassure that we are handling it and will keep them posted.
subj_en: Your loan is in processing
subj_es: Su prestamo esta en procesamiento

intent: Inform them the appraisal has been ordered/scheduled, explain simply what an appraisal is and why it matters, and that typically no action is needed from them. Give a timeline expectation.
subj_en: Your appraisal is on the way
subj_es: Su avaluo esta en camino

intent: Action needed: we need a few documents/conditions to keep the loan moving. Provide a clear checklist (placeholder items the LO will edit) and how to send them securely. Gentle urgency, supportive tone. Include 3-4 example checklist items.
subj_en: A few items needed to keep moving
subj_es: Necesitamos unos documentos para continuar

intent: Tell them the loan is in underwriting / final review. Explain what underwriting checks in plain terms and that they are almost there. Reassure we will update them quickly.
subj_en: Your loan is in final review
subj_es: Su prestamo esta en revision final

intent: Great news: they are Clear to Close. Explain what it means, that closing is coming, and what to expect next. Celebratory and warm.
subj_en: Great news, you are Clear to Close
subj_es: Excelente noticia, listo para cerrar

intent: Closing is scheduled. Share what to bring and what to expect at signing. CRITICAL: prominently warn about wire fraud and instruct them to verify any wiring instructions by calling a known, verified number, never trusting wire details sent by email. This email must make the wire-fraud warning highly visible.
subj_en: Your closing is scheduled
subj_es: Su cierre esta programado

intent: Congratulations, the keys are theirs. Heartfelt celebration of becoming a homeowner, gratitude for trusting WFG, and that we are here for them for life.
subj_en: Congratulations, the keys are yours
subj_es: Felicidades, las llaves son suyas

intent: Thank them again after closing and ask a small favor: refer friends and family, and optionally leave a review. Warm, gracious, not pushy.
subj_en: Thank you, and a small favor
subj_es: Gracias, y un pequeno favor

intent: 30 days after closing, check in on how they are settling into the home. Offer to answer any homeowner or mortgage questions and share helpful resources. Caring, relationship-building.
subj_en: How is the new home treating you?
subj_es: Como va todo en su nueva casa?

intent: Celebrate their one-year home anniversary. Warm congratulations and offer a complimentary annual mortgage review to make sure their loan still fits their life.
subj_en: Happy one-year home anniversary
subj_es: Feliz primer aniversario en su casa

intent: Let past clients know WFG watches the market for them and will reach out if refinancing could help their situation. Invite them to ask anytime. COMPLIANCE: no specific rate promises; refinancing may or may not benefit them and is subject to qualification.
subj_en: We are watching rates for you
subj_es: Estamos cuidando las tasas por usted

intent: Ask for referrals warmly. Their referrals are the highest compliment. Explain how easy it is to refer a friend or family member and that WFG will take great care of them.
subj_en: The best compliment you can give
subj_es: El mejor cumplido que nos puede dar

intent: Warm seasonal / holiday greeting from the WFG family. Pure gratitude and goodwill, no selling. Let them know we are thinking of them and here whenever they need us.
subj_en: From our family to yours
subj_es: De nuestra familia a la suya

intent: Processor funding email: final numbers, title company, where/how to bring funds.
Ask for a review about a week after closing.
Explain first payment timing + servicer autopay letter.
Homestead exemption explainer (TX).
Driver license address change reminder (~30 days).
Seasonal property tax protest reminder (TX, ~May 15).
Re-shop homeowners insurance at anniversary.
